title: Call Blocking Probability Using the Erlang B Formula
aim: Calculate call blocking probability for a cell and find the number of channels needed for a target grade of service.
method: Compute Erlang B recursively with B(E,0)=1 and B(E,k)=E*B(E,k-1)/(k+E*B(E,k-1)). Tabulate each load and channel count, then find the smallest m with B(10,m) <= 0.02.
result: Blocking falls as channels increase and rises as offered traffic increases. At 10 Erlangs, 17 channels meet the 2% grade-of-service target.
